decision_rule.close_or_narrow: If incompatible identities or permissions prevent a valid join, exclude that source/scope transparently; never synthesize labels.
decision_rule.proceed_to_modeling: Identity-consistent decision-time features and actual outcomes cover every reachable allowed first-stop choice for the declared restricted model task, with all missing/unavailable states explicit and group leakage controlled. This permits a separately frozen development comparison, not new policy timing or independent confirmation.
decision_rule.targeted_measurements: If a proposed model information/action/cost scope lacks actual outcomes or qualified feature/cost evidence, name the exact gaps and minimal future acquisition scope. Do not require blanket reacquisition if a supported restricted comparison can proceed.

operations: deterministic joins/counts and existing-output consistency checks
observed versus unknown outcome coverage by profile/filter/stage
existing acquisition cost coverage; no new scoring/fit/search
group overlap/exposure accounting without exporting query values
outputs: input hash inventory and preservation checks
prohibited: new database/native calls, local or Torch
new labels, interpolation or inferred counterfactual stop outcomes
rewriting frozen inputs or old receipts
reviewer: Codex evidence review; user receives permanent report

scope.excluded: Raw consumed-confirmation records, unexecuted 60-vector selective confirmation query values, 37 reserved-vector values, canonical calibration/final-test workloads, provider transcripts/credentials and unrelated workloads. Metadata receipt counts/hashes may be read without opening their raw protected data.
scope.permitted_inputs: Development-only trajectories, stop proofs, acquisition pairs, qualification records, sealed local definitions/profiles/manifests, raw locks, existing analysis/receipts and exposure metadata from the eight named source families.
scope.primary: Previously exposed 200 development vectors / 600 cases from feature-data and selective studies; original 100-vector four-condition subset is audited separately.
scope.retained_execution: Original execution. Preserve original/P2a/P2b and P2c conditioned timing scopes separately.

stop_rule: One bounded data-only audit. Preserve failures/unknowns. No experiment, modeling, runtime change or automatic measurement follows. Freeze any subsequent modeling/acquisition contract separately.
